title: Reintegration of Platform Workers to Traditional Employment through Support for Job Redesign Programme
what_it_is: Reintegration of Platform Workers to Traditional Employment through Support for Job Redesign Programme

sections.label: Platform workers programme not tracked
sections.summary: The programme does not target platform workers returning to traditional employment, and WSG does not track such transitions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The programme is not targeted at bringing platform workers back to traditional employment, as platform workers operate under different work arrangements from employees on FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Workforce Singapore (WSG) does not track the number of platform workers who transition to traditional employment through the programme.

sections.label: Government resources for platform workers
sections.summary: The Government provides resources like e2i career matching and schemes such as Career Conversion Programmes to help those leaving platform work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: In fact, for those who wish to transit out of platform work, the Government does provide much resources to help them plan their careers and strengthen their employability, such as the Employment and Employability Institute's career matching services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: There are also other schemes, such as the Career Conversion Programmes as well as the Mid-career Pathway Programme, SkillsFuture Transition Programmes, to improve their employability.
